'''Bunku Nagara''' ([[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] for "City of Palaces") was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. The city contained the [[Vatta Hutta]], a temple dedicated to the worship of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="LONH" />
